title: The seat plan
summary: The approved Specimen-sheet header (title block retired) saying the truth at first glance — no open seats, the bench list is open — over the page's own band: a floor plan of the firm as it is, one seat filled, the next one drawn and empty, each leaving through its own doorway on one straight line to the client's team, with nothing in between.
story: Opens the page on the honest zero-state and shows the firm's real shape in one drawing that reads as a plan: the firm's room (double-line walls, a lattice floor) with one seat filled (the founder) and the next seat dashed and empty (the one red — what opens next); each seat's line leaves through its own doorway and lands in the wall of the client's floor, a larger room named inside it; the dimension between the two rooms reads “No layer between”. A candidate learns there is no job today, what the firm adds next, and that the work is done straight with the client; a buyer reads the same drawing as a seniority signal. The facts ledger's door jumps to the bench list (#bench), where the page ends.
